subject: I-O status
notes: Rule: '00' = successful and no further information (cite.py --check 9.1.13.2 "I-O status = 00. The input-output statement is successfully executed and no further information is available" -> OK §9.1.13.2 1)). FileStatusCode.Success is the terminal value every connector returns on a plain success; the non-00 success values ('02','04','05','06','07','09') are each chosen ONLY by their own arm (IndexedConnector duplicateAlt, SequentialConnector ReadSucceeded arbitration, open-presence arms, FileRegistry NoRewind/CloseByFormat). Probes (pinned cobol.exe, out/probe/iostat-ix, iostat-rel, iostat-seq): plain WRITE/READ/REWRITE/START/OPEN/CLOSE all '00'; a REWRITE that leaves a permitted-duplicate alternate unchanged is '00' not '02' (RW-UNCHANGED=00). The golden l1_table20_seq_relative pins '00' across every legal Table 20 cell (spec-derived).
